You see Ancient Spawn Of Morgathla.

    Notes

    It looks like an Ancient Scarab with different colours. This boss has no cooldown; you can fight it again immediately after killing it.
    Part of the Dangerous Depths Quest.

    Abilities

    Unknown.

    Location

    Deep under the Gnome Deep Hub.

    Behaviour

    It fights in close combat. Ancient Spawn Of Morgathla never retreats.

    Strategy

    Be careful with the Burrowing Beetles and with the environment that will also cause you a lot of damage. Attack it while avoiding the Obsidian Pipes and the Sulphur Geysire around the rooms.
